column5: 0001082554-26-000006, FY2025 10-K: 'if we obtain FDA approval to update the Tyvaso DPI and/or Nebulized Tyvaso labeling to include an IPF indication, then the FDA should grant seven-year orphan drug exclusivity for this new indication'; the company expects review to be complete in late April 2027 (release 2026-09-02). Generic nebulized Tyvaso is settled for January 2026 without approval yet; a carved-out generic label could still be substituted before 2034
